title: Fast-path planner to sd show when the goal names a seed id
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/planner.md step 1 add: if the goal names a seed id, run sd show <id> directly; run sd ready only when it doesn't, and never run sd list to re-confirm a count sd ready already printed. Run 01M0WWKAQCWZC0Q0JK019H0ZC7's goal named fabro-f74b; sd ready returned exactly that one seed (seq 39), yet the planner still ran sd list --format json purely to double-check the count (reasoning at seq 67), after sd show + sd update + two globs + a full 10.4KB read of main.go — 7 tool calls and 76.6s inference for a single-candidate claim. Expected effect: two fewer shell calls and one LLM turn on named-seed runs, the common case for this workflow's goals. Overlaps the tracker-empty case in open fabro-b382 and fabro-e4fa; this covers the named-seed case.
closeReason: Superseded by fabro-7e88 (implemented in cycle 3, PR #25, e5f82da6c): same change — fast-path sd show when the goal names a seed id. Revisor journal of run 01M1RJVKW9 flagged the dangling duplicate; closed by the revisor-revisor pass (iterate skill, 2026-09-05).

title: Derive files_touched from the stage git diff, not write-tool calls
description: Engine-side: compute stage files_touched from the stage checkpoint's git diff (the data already exists per checkpoint, seq 194 of run 01M0WWKAQCWZC0Q0JK019H0ZC7). That run's implementer metadata reported files_touched: [README.md, main.go] (seq 190) while the actual stage diff — and the evidence capture — shows fib_test.go at +159/-28, the largest product change of the run, missed because the file was edited through shell (perl, head, heredoc append) invisible to write-tool instrumentation. Expected effect: accurate per-stage change attribution with no silently missing files for any consumer keying on files_touched.

title: Classify evidence-pipe workarounds as painpoints in develop stage prompts
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/reviewer.md and implementer.md (Journal section), add one sentence: a successful workaround of the evidence pipe, tools, or scripts is a painpoint with its fix idea, not an observation. In run 01M11P68SHFS165HP9ATK6094V every stage emitted painpoints: [] while the blob-truncation fallback, the per-seed-base idea, and the missing python3/node were logged under observations, where the improve loop that keys on painpoints may never act on them. Orthogonal to open seed fabro-b809 (channel emission, not content classification). Expected effect: genuine fixes reach the improve loop journal on the run where they happen.

title: Tell develop reviewer to read blob refs with read_file offset/limit
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/reviewer.md (Input section, blob-ref paragraph), state that blob files are read with read_file (offset/limit for large blobs). reviewer@3 in run 01M11P68SHFS165HP9ATK6094V found python3/node unavailable and improvised nu str substring chunking on a 58.1 KB evidence blob because the prompt never mentions the sanctioned path. Expected effect: removes improvised-read friction; pairs with open seeds fabro-8d2c/fabro-d97b.

title: Require ml record for implementer near-miss tool lessons
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/implementer.md step 6 (or the stage-journal hook), make ml record mandatory for near-miss tool lessons. implementer@1's edit_file old_string swallowed a whole test loop body in fib_test.go, was caught only by re-reading, and the lesson went into the run journal that no future session loads; implementer@2 then spent 284 s / 0.49 USD (42% of run agent cost) editing the same 1,100-line table-literal file without the guardrail. Expected effect: the next implementer inherits the scoped-old_string guardrail via ml prime --files.

title: Declare lesson_capture in the implementer node's context_allow_keys
description: Seed fabro-f831 makes lesson_capture a required key of the Implemented JSON in .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/implementer.md, but workflow.fabro's implementer node still declares context_allow_keys=implementation_summary,journal, so the undeclared key drops as drift on every future pass (per fabro-900e comment). Change: one line in workflow.fabro implementer node — context_allow_keys=implementation_summary,lesson_capture,journal; optionally also add it to the reviewer's preamble_allow_keys. Effect: the enforced record-or-skip answer lands durably instead of being discarded.
closeReason: Closed 2026-09-05 triage: lesson_capture already declared in implementer context_allow_keys (workflow.fabro line 106).

title: Add a repo-layout map to the planner prompt or AGENTS.md
description: planner@1 burned 354.7 s / $0.219 of the $0.547 total (50,460 input tokens) on ~10 exploratory calls just to locate dev-loop assets that live at .fabro/workflows/develop/ in the same repo; planner@2 with the layout in context took 98 s / $0.064. Change: add a 5-line Repo layout section to AGENTS.md (loaded as memory into every stage) or .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/planner.md: gofib at repo root; dev-loop assets at .fabro/workflows/develop/; reviews at .fabro/reviews/; journals at .fabro/journal/. Effect: first planner pass drops from ~6 min toward ~100 s — roughly −4.5 min wall and −$0.15 per run. Distinct from the sd call-economy seeds (fabro-e4fa/f4cd/1399): those tune tracker calls, this removes filesystem orientation calls.

title: Emit a loop-work diff in evidence.nu when only churn files changed
description: Seeds targeting .fabro/ paths are classified as loop churn by .fabro/workflows/develop/scripts/evidence.nu, so captures read seed-work=0 files +0/-0 and reviewers must run their own git diff. Change: in evidence.nu, when seed_rows is empty but churn_rows is not, emit the per-seed (claim-base) diff of changed loop files under a loop-work diff section — the per-seed diff-base machinery from fabro-1e9f's theme already provides the base. Effect: reviews of dev-loop seeds verify from context, removing the per-review git detour. Cross-ref: fabro-1e9f (diff against last seed boundary) is the same machinery at run level.

title: Ban sd prime in develop planner and implementer prompts
description: planner@1 executed sd prime because AGENTS.md memory instructs it, pulling a 4.7 KB banner whose Session Close Protocol mandates sd close + sd sync && git push — both reserved for the deterministic Closeout; the planner journaled that an LLM skimming the banner could comply. Change: one line in .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/planner.md and prompts/implementer.md: never run sd prime in this loop — its close/push protocol contradicts the role rules and the context brief supersedes it. Effect: removes a directly contradicting instruction from every stage context and eliminates the mis-close/push risk. Complements the AGENTS.md boilerplate fix in fabro-cc23.

title: Make the authorized-exception pattern standing in the implementer prompt
description: Briefs carry manual override prose (fabro-f831's brief opened with CONTRADICTION RESOLVED authorizing exactly one .fabro/ file), and implementer@2 journaled that the pattern recurred across fabro-7e44 and fabro-f831 and deserves a platform-level convention. Change: in .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/implementer.md's Platform scope section add: exception — a brief that names a specific platform file authorizes editing exactly that file. Effect: planner briefs shed roughly a third of their text and the implementer no longer reconciles a contradiction before starting.

title: Require null-path exercises when editing workflow scripts
description: implementer@1 found a latent crash — a string-typed Nushell param rejects runtime null, which would have crashed evidence.nu's no-seed-in-progress path (mulch mx-0b966a) — surfaced only because that brief happened to demand fallback/null/empty-diff exercises; the gate's nu-check is syntax-only. Change: add to .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/implementer.md step 2: when editing workflow scripts, exercise the null/no-seed/fallback paths via nu -c before finishing. Effect: rarely-hit paths get verified on every workflow-script seed, not only when a brief remembers to ask.

title: Path-scope the tester gate for prompt-only seeds
description: Both tester runs executed the full Go gate (build/vet/test, 11.1 s cold, 1.1 s cached) on a tree where gofib was never touched — both seeds changed only .fabro/ and .mulch/ files. Change: route a lite path (e.g. a just qualitygate-lite running nu-check + sync) from the same tester node when only .fabro//.md files changed. Effect: seconds per cycle, and a structurally meaningless check disappears from dev-loop seeds; lowest impact of this run's findings.

title: Add evidence to the reviewer's preamble_stages_ignore
description: reviewer@2's prompt carried the identical ~2 KB evidence capture twice plus two tester sections and the prior cycle's closeout block, because preamble_stages_ignore keeps tester+evidence per visit and command.output dedups into the evidence stage section rather than replacing it. Change: in workflow.fabro, add evidence to the reviewer node's preamble_stages_ignore — the current capture still arrives via the command.output context key, which the prompt already teaches the reviewer to read as a blob ref. Effect: ~2 KB less preamble per review cycle and stale prior-cycle captures disappear. Complements open fabro-699f (latest-visit rendering) with a different mechanism.

title: develop planner: close the ## Context input contract (preamble_allow_keys) — implementer already closed
description:
Counterpart to the implementer fix landed 2026-09-03 on denkhaus-lab (commit 9a3131945, synced to this branch in 1c231a039): the implementer node now has preamble_allow_keys = the seed trio, so the planner's journal/painpoints no longer leak into its ## Context section.

Still open: the PLANNER node has no preamble_allow_keys. Its ## Context section renders unfiltered — the implementer's implementation_summary, the latest journal payload (implementer painpoints after an implementer pass), and any future key another node starts writing all ride into planning. Input contract per the planner prompt should be: current_seed_id, current_seed_title, current_seed_brief (its own writes), review_verdict + review_feedback (reviewer bounce inputs). Verify against prompts/planner.md before setting; land as one attribute with a dated comment, same as the implementer fix. Delayed deliberately: one graph change at a time before the fib qualification runs (fabro-03ef verification), then close this.

title: tests: parse_auth_logout_all/parse_settings_command are FABRO_SERVER-env-sensitive (fail in shells that export FABRO_SERVER)
description:
## Failure (observed 2026-09-04)

`cargo nextest run -p fabro-cli parse_auth_logout_all parse_settings_command` passes in a clean environment (run 01M1PVMS7B6N39MG0041C5F7P6 sandbox: 2/2 PASS) but fails deterministically in any shell that exports FABRO_SERVER (e.g. agent/dev shells after fabro CLI use): `ServerTargetArgs.server` is `Option<String>` with `#[arg(long = "server", env = EnvVars::FABRO_SERVER)]`, so clap populates the value from the environment and the tests' `.is_none()` assertions fail (main.rs ~710, ~1583).

fabro-8822's original failing-tests premise is therefore resolved on HEAD for clean environments (both parse tests pass; no clap default_value exists) — what remains is test hygiene: the tests must be invariant to ambient FABRO_SERVER.

## Fix

Scrub the env var in these tests (std::env::remove_var guarded by a lock, or clap's test-friendly env handling / `#[cfg(test)]` env_reset), or assert against `resolve_nondefault_server_target` semantics instead of the raw parsed field. Do NOT weaken to is_some.

## Acceptance

- both tests pass with FABRO_SERVER=http://127.0.0.1:32276 exported into the test process
- both tests keep passing with it unset

title: sandbox: pre-trust the repo mise config in run containers (planner burns turns on `mise trust`)
description:
Adopted from run 01M1PVMS7B6N39MG0041C5F7P6 planner painpoint.

## Failure

At pass start `sd` was unusable: the mise shim refused every command because /repos/denkhaus/fabro/.mise.toml was untrusted ("Config files ... are not trusted"). The planner burned LLM turns discovering and running `mise trust /repos/denkhaus/fabro/.mise.toml`.

## Fix directions

- toolchain image (fabro-toolchain, .fabro/Dockerfile.toolchain): bake the mise trust state for the canonical clone path, or set MISE_YES/trust-related env so tool shims work without interaction (coordinate with fabro-a54d/fabro-80ec toolchain baking).
- or sandbox init: run `mise trust` for the repo config as part of workspace setup.

## Acceptance

A fresh develop run's first `sd` invocation works with zero planner-side bootstrap actions.

title: sd CLI default --limit 50 silently hides goal-mandated seeds from the planner
description:
Adopted from run 01M1PVMS7B6N39MG0041C5F7P6 planner painpoint.

## Failure

`sd ready` and `sd list` both default to `--limit 50`. After the tracker consolidation (109 open seeds, ~50 High), the goal-mandated seed fabro-8822 (priority 2) was truncated out of BOTH listings — the seed looked absent until the planner retried with `--limit 200`.

## Fix directions

- develop planner prompt (this repo, .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/planner.md sd reference): pin `--limit 200` on tracker listings — partially adopted 2026-09-04.
- upstream seeds CLI: warn when output is truncated by the limit (external repo, @os-eco/seeds-cli).
- tracker hygiene: keep open-seed count under the limit (priority discipline).

## Acceptance

A goal naming a priority-2 seed resolves via `sd` listings without manual limit guessing.

title: unexplained: .fabro/project.toml truncated to 0 bytes at 2026-09-04 23:08 (no identified writer)
description:
## Failure (observed 2026-09-04)

During the closeout-stdin diagnosis window, .fabro/project.toml was truncated to 0 bytes on the denkhaus working tree (mtime 2026-09-04 23:08:02 +0200, between commits cef7c2497 20:19 and f7db7d05a 23:10 — the slimmed 505-byte content was committed and intact before, gone after). No recurrence after restore (checked again ~23:37 and later); the file holds the slim project-root content.

Ruled out by reproduction (file stayed 505 bytes): `nu closeout.nu` (with sd shim), `fabro ps`, `fabro validate develop`, `fabro preflight develop`. Ruled out by timing: `fabro run` create (23:20) and `just up` rebuild window. Candidates not yet excluded: an interrupted IPython cell in that window, the edit skill, mise activation side effects.

## Impact if it recurs

A zero-byte project.toml still parses (empty layer) but silently breaks project discovery semantics; a run create from such a tree warns about the dirty worktree.

## Fix

If it recurs: run the watcher (`stat` poll loop) or inotify on the file, capture the writing PID (fanotify/auditd), and check whether any fabro-config write path can open project.toml O_TRUNC (grep for `File::create` near project config). Watcher was prepared but not running when last checked.

title: Add repair-and-resume from checkpoint for deterministic config failures
description: Run 01M0QJ01P9E6EKX8S6TQN91G8E: planner died on its first LLM call (invalid reasoning_effort pin — root cause tracked as fabro-b158) and the run went terminal with 'goal gate unsatisfied for node planner and no retry target', even though event seq 43 checkpointed the failed-planner state. Engine/graph change: allow a terminally failed run to resume from its checkpoint after the underlying config is fixed (or add a hold node before terminal exit). Expected effect: a 10-second human fix continues the run at node cost instead of forcing a fresh run with another ~33s sandbox/clone/mise/bootstrap setup. Distinct from closed fabro-18a5 (terminal classification) and open fabro-53d3 (Blocked edge): different mechanism — checkpoint-based repair. Cross-reference fabro-b440 (fork-from-checkpoint ends terminal failed) — complementary cases, same checkpoint machinery.

title: Make engine checkpoint metadata snapshots async or branch-point-only
description: Engine checkpoint pipeline: make the metadata snapshot fire-and-forget async, or run it only on branch/failure nodes (tester/evidence/reviewer exits), not the happy path. In run 01M0WWKAQCWZC0Q0JK019H0ZC7 every checkpoint paid a synchronous ~2.5s snapshot (2.30s init seq 22, 2.49s after planner seq 80, 2.63s after evidence seq 213; ~17s, 6% of the 293s wall) on a linear zero-retry path nothing ever resumes from. Complements open fabro-c2ca (config-level skip for non-agent stages only — the planner snapshot here is an agent stage and would remain). Expected effect: ~15-17s shaved per seed cycle, compounding on multi-seed runs.

title: Legalize sd list for goal-condition open-seed verification in planner prompt
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/planner.md, reword the sd table: sd list is expected when the goal requires confirming no other open seed remains (blocked-but-open seeds are invisible to sd ready, which lists unblocked only). In run 01M0WWKAQCWZC0Q0JK019H0ZC7 the planner correctly ran sd list --format json (seq 68) despite the prompt's do NOT also run sd list rule — the rule must be disobeyed to route closeout correctly. Reconcile with fabro-e4fa/fabro-b382: b382's sd ready empty → route Tracker empty, do not run sd list would misroute while blocked-but-open seeds remain. Expected effect: no must-be-disobeyed instruction; wrongful Tracker empty closeout routing guarded.

title: Bump evidence diff context from -U1 to -U3
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/scripts/evidence.nu, change the single git diff -U1 to -U3. In run 01M0WWKAQCWZC0Q0JK019H0ZC7 the reviewer journal admits it trusted the green gate plus pinning tests rather than re-deriving the range math because -U1 omitted where start/last are computed in run() — the exact code the seed was about. Not covered by open seeds: fabro-3c9d is sort+budget, fabro-1e9f is diff base, fabro-4b57 is loop-work diff. Expected effect: range/validation logic verifiable in-diff; approvals-by-trust at the core seam eliminated.
closeReason: Closed 2026-09-05 triage: evidence.nu already emits git diff -U3 (seed work section, lines 258/267).

title: Classify user aborts and sandbox deaths as cancellation, not deterministic failure
description: In run 01M0QJ5FNE9XZJ72YN31K3X451, implementer@2's termination on user request ('beende den run') plus Docker 409 (container not running) was recorded with category: deterministic and entered loop_failure_signatures, polluting the failure ledger with an interruption that is not a defect. Change: in the workflow engine's failure classification (fabro-workflow), give user-abort/sandbox-death a distinct cancellation category; interim: in .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/implementer.md, route user-stop as 'interrupted' rather than Blocked. Expected effect: failure signatures stay meaningful and retry/health metrics stop counting operator stops as reproducible failures. No existing seed matches (searched deterministic failure, cancellation, failure signature, user abort; fabro-ca74 covers CLI lifecycle commands, a different mechanism).

title: Tell the implementer to edit one file sequentially, never as parallel batches
description: Add one line to the output-hygiene section of prompts/implementer.md: multiple edits to the same file must be issued sequentially, or the final content emitted once via write_file. Evidence from run 01M0QTNF6GWHGPKHSQ2Y2PB8CQ: worker log 17:31:51 shows six WARN fabro_agent::write_locks: concurrent write to the same file in one batch; serializing events when the implementer fired ~6 parallel edit_file calls at fib_test.go — all serialized into wasted tool round trips. Expected effect: fewer wasted tool round trips per implementer stage and the lock warnings disappear from run logs. Distinct from open fabro-0bfd (engine-side log-count rendering) and closed fabro-facd (harness clobber fix): this is prompt-side prevention.

title: Add a deterministic tracker guard node before the planner
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/workflow.fabro add a script node after start that runs sd list (default output is OPEN issues only, which includes blocked-open seeds — sd ready alone lists unblocked only and would misroute per fabro-aa3d) and sd list --status in_progress; when both are empty, route Tracker empty directly to exit, else continue to planner. Grounded in run 01M0SFEYVC9TD6MP816RHEBFQY: planner@1 spent 27.7s wall / 25.4s inference / $0.0186 (events seq 40-55) solely to discover what ~1.3s of shell proves (6 closed seeds, 0 open). All existing planner-call-economy seeds (fabro-1399, fabro-b382, fabro-e4fa, fabro-aa3d) are prompt edits; none moves the empty-tracker check out of the agent. Expected effect: the common drained-tracker terminal case costs zero agent tokens; planner only runs when there is something to plan.

title: Document sd list read semantics in the planner prompt
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/planner.md, extend the tracker mechanics with: sd list without --status returns OPEN issues only; valid --status values are open|in_progress|closed (there is no all); sd list --status closed confirms the tracker is readable and drained. Grounded in run 01M0SFEYVC9TD6MP816RHEBFQY: the planner's reasoning (event seq 46) doubted whether count=0 meant open-only, probed sd list --status all (seq 48), got a CLI error, and burned one wasted ~7s LLM round-trip before routing Tracker empty. Complements open fabro-1399 (which covers write syntax and call order, not read-flag semantics). Expected effect: one fewer inference turn per planner invocation and faster correct Tracker-empty routing.

title: Route no-change verification resubmits straight to reviewer
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/workflow.fabro, add an 'Implemented (no changes)' label edge from implementer directly to reviewer, or condition the tester edge on a dirty worktree. In run 01M0SS23MJM8972CBJD0SP7T4Q, tester@2 (922ms) and evidence@2 (384ms) re-ran on a byte-identical worktree because implementer@2 was verification-only by design; the unconditional edge from implementer to tester wastes one gate plus evidence pair per procedural resubmit, and the waste scales with gate weight.

title: Clear review_feedback in the reviewer Approved JSON template
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/reviewer.md, add "review_feedback": "" to the Approved JSON template so the verdict flip resets stale rejection text. In run 01M0SS23MJM8972CBJD0SP7T4Q, planner@3 still carried the full 1.6KB cycle-1 'changes requested' feedback alongside review_verdict=approved, letting dead instructions leak into the next seed's re-plan. Complements fabro-5870 (closeout clearing): this triggers at verdict flip, mid-loop.
closeReason: Closed 2026-09-05 triage: Approved JSON template no longer carries review_feedback.

title: Document glob_filter glob syntax in the planner prompt
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/planner.md, note that the grep tool's glob_filter expects a glob (e.g. *.go), not a bare filename like main.go. In run 01M0SS23MJM8972CBJD0SP7T4Q, planner@1 burned two empty grep calls (seq 58-59 with glob_filter: "main.go") plus a recovery find/head call; the prompt note prevents those wasted turns independently of fabro-8354 landing ripgrep in the image.

title: Blank stale seed context keys when routing Tracker empty
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/planner.md, extend the 'Tracker empty' JSON contract to also blank current_seed_id/title/brief and implementation_summary (it already clears review_verdict). In run 01M0T9B7T6XNM1D7JNY35Y6H8K the final planner pass closed seed fabro-8208, routed 'Tracker empty', yet its prompt still carried the dead seed's brief (1.6 KB) and implementation_summary (1.7 KB) as blob refs after budget demotion. Expected effect: the closing planner pass stops hauling stale seed context — fewer blob round-trips, smaller preambles, lower risk of the evidence-starvation pathology noted in the graph comments. Not a duplicate of fabro-b382, which covers prose duplication and sd call rules, not the context_updates key contract.

title: Make seeds-cli exit non-zero on errors (exit 0 masks failed tracker writes)
description: @os-eco/seeds-cli v0.5.15 prints errors like 'error: unknown option --format' to stdout with exit_code 0 — observed at events seq 62-63 of run 01M0T9B7T6XNM1D7JNY35Y6H8K when planner@1 ran sd update with --format json; only the model's text inspection caught the failed write. Change: seeds-cli exits non-zero and prints errors to stderr. Expected effect: removes a silent-corruption path for tracker writes (any exit-code-checking consumer or gate currently reads failure as success) and eliminates the observed wasted retry. Prompt-side syntax pinning is already covered by fabro-1399; this is the orthogonal CLI-side fix.

title: Steer implementer to mechanical shell bulk edits for repetitive rewrites
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/implementer.md, add one paragraph: for repetitive, pattern-shaped changes (call-site adaptation, renames), do one mechanical pass via shell (sd/perl -pi -e, already pinned in the runner image) and verify with one focused test, instead of N hand edits. Evidence: implementer@2 (fabro-28e8) was 42% of run cost ($0.486, 278s, 51.8k tokens) rewriting ~24 identical call sites one edit_file at a time, with 19 concurrent-write serialization warnings across passes and one swallowed-loop-body near-miss. Expected effect: refactor-class pass drops from ~$0.49/280s toward ~$0.12/112s; run cost -20-25%; eliminates the swallow-adjacent-code near-miss class. Distinct from fabro-4601 (sequential-edit discipline, different mechanism).

title: web: files tab refuses large diffs ('too large to render inline') — offer truncated/per-record rendering
description: User report 2026-09-05: in a run's Files tab, the diff for .seeds/issues.jsonl (182 records / ~264KB) is refused with '.seeds/issues.jsonl too large to render inline', so revisor-filed seeds cannot be reviewed in the UI at all. Wanted: at minimum a truncated diff with explicit cut + full-diff download; ideally per-record (JSONL line) diff rendering so one revisor cycle's additions are readable. Basis: revisor run on denkhaus, Files tab, 2026-09-05.

title: web: kanban run tiles — show run date, workflow name, and workflow version
description: User request 2026-09-05: the kanban run tiles currently show only title, diff status, repo, and PR numbers. Wanted additionally on each tile: (1) the run date (created_at or last activity), (2) the workflow name, (3) the workflow version. The workflow_version_id is content-derived (SHA-256 of the canonical workflow package) and exposed by the API run record as workflow.workflow_version_id (runs list since ADR-0015 engine change, 2026-09-05); render a short form (first ~12 hex chars) so tiles stay compact. Complements fabro-d5a6 (large-diff rendering); together they close the run-identity visibility gap in the UI.

title: State the fs_hide shell bypass plainly in develop prompts
description: In .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/implementer.md (Platform scope section) and prompts/planner.md (ADR-0015 stale-basis step), replace the claim 'writes are denied (fabro-1dae fs_hide)' — disproved in the target run — with explicit guidance that for platform-targeting seeds, .fabro/** reads/writes go through the shell because fs_hide binds tool calls only (implementer read_file denied at seq 145, then 3 discovery calls before a python3 heredoc edit at seq 174; planner forced into shell fallback at seq 83). Effect: 3-4 tool calls and 2-3 LLM turns saved per platform-targeting seed, and prompts stop asserting unenforced behavior. Basis: run 01M1RF53QWM4Q5REBVSG9F9Y43, workflow version absent, commit 3ca43b1cd19c8cf291668bdbdc4a1fbbc321e2ec

title: Fast-path sd show <id> in planner when the goal names a seed id
description: Add one rule to .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/planner.md step 1: if the goal names a seed id, run 'sd show <id> --format json' first and only fall back to 'sd ready' if the id does not resolve. In the target run the goal contained fabro-37a6 yet step 1 ran 'sd ready --limit 200', pulling 118 issues / 13.9 KB truncated output next to the sd show in the same batch (seq 65-68). Effect: ~14 KB less context and one fewer call in the run's most expensive stage (planner = 63% of run cost). Basis: run 01M1RF53QWM4Q5REBVSG9F9Y43, workflow version absent, commit 3ca43b1cd19c8cf291668bdbdc4a1fbbc321e2ec

title: Lint filed seeds for resolvable basis refs and tool-name typos
description: In the seed-intake path of the revisor/improve workflow (the stage writing .seeds/issues.jsonl), require a resolvable run-id/Basis line per ADR-0015 and flag tool-name typos against the pinned-toolchain list. Seed fabro-37a6 shipped three defects the planner burned high-effort reasoning resolving: 'sd' as a typo for 'sed', unresolvable evidence ref fabro-28e8, and a call-site count (~24) conflicting with the recorded one (~40). Effect: planner passes stop paying the contradiction-resolution premium and ambiguous briefs — a known reviewer ping-pong driver — are caught before a run starts.
